summary: A residential building at 255 King Street: the Department of Building Inspection filed its new-construction permit in July 2000 (16 stories, 250 units) and recorded it completed on 2004-09-21, while the Assessor roll gives 2003 as year built, 256 units and 19 stories.

open_questions: No source read states that 255 King St is the AvalonBay property called 'Avalon at Mission Bay' or that it is the first of three phases: 'Avalon at Mission Bay I' is this project's own label. Rental-listing pages name 255 King St 'Avalon at Mission Bay' but give conflicting unit counts, and were seen only as search snippets, not opened.

Developer (AvalonBay Communities) and architect not confirmed by any source read; Arquitectonica's 'Avalon Mission Bay' page (407,000 SF, 260 units) gives no address or year and may describe a different phase.
The permit completed date (2004-09-21) and the Assessor year built (2003) disagree by about a year; the permit date is a closeout record. No opening month found.
The permit is recorded under block 8706 lot 001, a different lot from the Assessor parcel 8706010; the relationship (condominium or subdivision lots) is not explained in any source read.
